speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: We will continue to review the eligibility criteria for FAS regularly.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The latest review was at Budget 2018, just recently, where we extended the scheme to cover more students.

speaker: Mr Azmoon Ahmad (Nominated Member)
text: Can the Senior Parliamentary Secretary share with us how many students were under FAS in 2017?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: I do not have the figures right now.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: If the Member would like to, he can file another Parliamentary Question.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Nevertheless, I assure the Member that we want to help as many students as possible.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We are committed to providing quality and affordable education to all Singaporeans, regardless of their financial circumstances.
